analyst_task: Open Evidence and identify the strongest demand source plus one material limitation.
Open Numbers and verify the displayed gross-margin and operating-margin calculations against the three exact facts.
Open Workpaper and identify the weakest of the ten judgments and the modification required.
Open Deliverable and decide whether the no-source Writer draft is useful as a starting point, not whether it is release-ready.
senior_task: Locate the candidate sources and modification point for each material Writer section used in the review sample.
Record approve, conditional approve, or return-for-follow-up against the exact analysis digest.
Permit no more than the bounded follow-up listed in the shadow senior R2 report.

acceptance_rule.minimum: actual user completes all four analyst tasks and a senior decision is recorded against the exact digest
acceptance_rule.product_value: scores and time are baseline observations, not a fabricated time-saved claim
acceptance_rule.release_effect: RG3 and RG4 remain blocked until completed values and an exact human senior decision are recorded
